definitions.explanation: A school administrator who assists the {校長|こうちょう} (principal) and carries out duties delegated by the principal. The position was formally established in Japanese public schools by a 2007 revision of the School Education Act, sitting between the principal and the older {教頭|きょうとう} rank.

examples.japanese: {副校長|ふくこうちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To take up the post of vice-principal.

examples.japanese: {副校長|ふくこうちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全|ぜん}{校|こう}→全校：28166_zenkou⟧⟦{集会|しゅうかい}→集会：14654_shuukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧あいさつ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The vice-principal gave an address at the all-school assembly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦{不在|ふざい}→不在：11302_fuzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{副校長|ふくこうちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When the principal is absent, the vice-principal represents the school.

notes:
Formed with the prefix ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧- ('vice-; deputy') attached to ⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧ ('school principal'). The position was added to the standard hierarchy of Japanese public schools by the 2007 revision of the ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧{教育法|きょういくほう}, creating a formal deputy layer above the longstanding ⟦{教頭|きょうとう}→教頭：16380_kyoutou⟧ rank.

USAGE:
- Used in elementary, middle, and high schools, including both public and private institutions.
- In everyday school contexts, students and parents usually encounter the {副校長|ふくこうちょう} when the ⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧ is unavailable for ceremonies, meetings, or announcements.
- Some schools have a {副校長|ふくこうちょう} but no ⟦{教頭|きょうとう}→教頭：16380_kyoutou⟧; others have both; the exact staffing varies by school size and board policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副校長|ふくこうちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appoint as vice-principal
- {副校長|ふくこうちょう}⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: (addressing) the vice-principal teacher
- {副校長|ふくこうちょう}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧: vice-principal's office
- {副校長|ふくこうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as vice-principal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧: school principal — the head of the school, whom the {副校長|ふくこうちょう} supports.
- ⟦{教頭|きょうとう}→教頭：16380_kyoutou⟧: head teacher — the older deputy-rank title, still widely used; typically ranks below {副校長|ふくこうちょう} when both positions exist.
- ⟦{学長|がくちょう}→学長：29864_gakuchou⟧: university president — equivalent head position at a university; does not use the {校|こう} element.
- ⟦{園長|えんちょう}→園長：27936_enchou⟧: head of a kindergarten or nursery — equivalent for preschool institutions.
